notes: State category A. Appraisal districts may also file townhomes and condominium units here; refine with district subcodes (e.g. TCAD A1, A2...) once a district's code table (STATE_CD.TXT) is read.

State category B covers buildings with more than one dwelling; the category alone does not say how many, and land_use_std has no 2+-unit value, so OTHER (not MULTIFAMILY_5P) until district subcodes split duplexes, 3-4 and 5+.
State category C1 (vacant lots and land tracts). Some vacant commercial lots may be filed here; district subcodes can separate them.
State category C2 (lots in colonias, generally unimproved residential lots).

State category C (Comptroller Property Classification Guide). Catches district subcodes beyond C1 and C2, such as C3 'rural vacant lot' (Harris and others). Some vacant commercial lots may be filed here, as with C1.
State category D1 (land with an agricultural or open-space valuation).
State category D2 (farm and ranch improvements on qualified land).
State category E (rural land without an ag valuation, including rural homesites): mixed uses, so OTHER.
State category G (oil, gas and other minerals).
State category L1 (business personal property, not land; real-property rows only are loaded).
State category L2 (industrial personal property, not land).
State category O (lots and homes held for sale by a developer or builder): mostly new subdivision lots, some with a house under construction.
State category S (dealer inventory: vehicles, boats, manufactured housing for sale).
State category X (Comptroller Property Classification Guide): government, school, church, charity and other wholly exempt property, with district subcodes (X1, X2, XV ...). Not counted as homes.
